ladder_payload.title: Undefined variable total
ladder_payload.l0_decode: The editor cannot find a value with this name at this point of the program.
ladder_payload.l1_locate: Where in your code does this name get its first value?

l2_concept.rule: A name must have a value before a line reads it.

l3_fix.change: Give the variable a starting value before the loop.
l3_fix.why: Then the name exists when the loop reads it for the first time.
